text_plugin_synopsis: File manager plugin. View images with zoom, metadata, sharing, and safe external fallback
p_languages_all_supported_for_readme: The current README.md supports the following languages
p_introduction: Image Viewer provides the primary image-viewing action for supported files in the file manager. It opens a temporary read-only content URI in a focused viewer without changing the source file.
features: Registers a protocol v2 primary Explorer action for the eight image extensions previously viewed by the host.
Fits the image to the screen and supports focal pinch zoom, panning, double-tap reset, and tap-to-hide controls.
Displays the file name, MIME type, size, and decoded resolution.
Shares the image or opens it in another compatible app while excluding this plugin from its own fallback.
Provides an independent Android `ACTION_VIEW` gateway for read-only `content` URIs with `image/*` MIME types.
p_supported_formats: The Explorer primary action matches these extensions exactly
p_plugin_interface: The host discovers and executes the plugin with the following identities
p_plugin_scope: Version 1 supplies the primary image action in the file manager. Image editing, conversion, file information, deletion, moving, and renaming remain host features. Without the plugin, the host falls back to a read-only external `ACTION_VIEW` request.
p_plugin_packaging: Host build 5269 or later is required.
p_security: The plugin requests no storage or network permission. The host grants temporary read-only access to the target content URI. The Explorer gateway verifies the exact action, URI, ClipData, file name, MIME type, declared size, and parent relationship, rejects write or persistable grants, and never writes the source. The external `ACTION_VIEW` gateway is separate, accepts only read-only `content` image URIs, and forwards only the validated target URI.
security_limits: External `ACTION_VIEW`: read-only `content` URIs with `image/*` MIME types.
Actual decoding support still depends on Android and Glide.
Image editing, conversion, deletion, moving, and renaming are outside this plugin.
p_build_params: Build parameters come from `version.properties`. The current minimum SDK is 24 and the target SDK is 36
p_resource_layout: `strings.xml` localizes plugin metadata and UI text. `plugin_instruction.md` provides instructions shown by the host. `.python/generate_markdown.py` generates localized README and changelog files from JSON sources
